name: Reduce appointment no-shows and refill cancelled slots from a waitlist with Google Calendar, Twilio and AI

parameters.content:
## Reduce appointment no-shows and refill cancelled slots from a waitlist with Google Calendar, Twilio and AI

### How it works

1. Every 15 minutes the Google Calendar is read. Clients are asked to confirm by SMS or email 48 hours ahead, and asked again at 24 hours.
2. A cancellation by reply, or an appointment removed from the calendar, frees the slot. The waitlist is offered it a few people at a time, and the first yes is booked.
3. Before booking, the calendar is checked again, so a slot sold online in the meantime is never booked twice. Moving up frees the later slot for the next person.
4. Replies are read with AI, keywords first. Out-of-office replies are ignored and STOP is honoured.
5. Clients with repeated no-shows are asked for a deposit.
6. Recalls go out when a service is due again.
7. The front desk gets a daily list of who to call, and the owner a Monday report of the money recovered.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Connect Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Gmail, Twilio and OpenAI.
- [ ] Create one sheet with four tabs: Clients, Services, Waitlist, Log.
- [ ] Fill Set Clinic Settings, and translate Set Message Texts if needed.
- [ ] Mark a no-show by colouring the event red (Tomato) or writing "no-show" in it.

### Customization

The hours, waves, deposit rule and recall pace are in Set Clinic Settings. Leave the Twilio number empty to use email only.

## Start on a timer or reply

The planner runs every 15 minutes. Replies arrive by text through Twilio or by email through Gmail, and are handled as they come.

## Set your clinic and texts

The only two nodes you edit. **Set Message Texts** holds every word a client reads: translate it once.

assignments.name: confirm
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, this is {business}. Your {service} is on {day} at {time}. Reply YES to confirm or NO to cancel.

assignments.name: confirm_deposit
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, this is {business}. Your {service} is on {day} at {time}. To keep it, please pay the deposit here: {deposit_link} and reply YES. Reply NO to cancel.

assignments.name: nudge
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, we still need to hear from you about your {service} on {day} at {time}. Reply YES to keep it or NO to free it for someone else.

assignments.name: confirmed
assignments.value: Thank you {first_name}, see you on {day} at {time}.

assignments.name: cancelled
assignments.value: Your {service} on {day} at {time} is cancelled. To book another time: {link}

assignments.name: offer
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, a {service} slot just opened at {business}: {day} at {time}. Reply YES to take it. First to reply gets it.

assignments.name: offer_move_up
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, an earlier {service} slot opened at {business}: {day} at {time}, instead of {old_day} at {old_time}. Reply YES to move up. First to reply gets it.

assignments.name: booked
assignments.value: Booked: your {service} is on {day} at {time}. See you then!

assignments.name: taken
assignments.value: Sorry {first_name}, that slot has just been taken. You are still on our list.

assignments.name: recall
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, it is time for your next {service} at {business}. Book here: {link} or reply YES and we will call you.

assignments.name: recall_reminder
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, a reminder that your {service} is due. Book here: {link}

assignments.name: recall_yes
assignments.value: Thank you {first_name}, we will be in touch to find a time. You can also book here: {link}

assignments.name: opted_out
assignments.value: You will not receive any more automatic messages from {business}.

parameters.content:
## Load clients, services and waitlist

The three tabs the front desk keeps. Each **Aggregate** folds a read into one item, so the next read runs once.

## Load the calendar and log

Two days back and 60 ahead, and the Log tab: the only tab this workflow writes, and only by adding rows.

## Plan what happens next

Confirmations, the second ask, waitlist offers, no-shows, recalls, the daily list and the Monday report: all decided here.

## Write the log first

Every decision is a row before anything is sent, so a failed text is never sent twice.

## Send by text or email

Each client's own channel, never one they said STOP to. Front desk and owner always get email.

## Read who replied and why

Out-of-office replies and strangers are dropped. Keywords decide first; AI reads the rest and must quote its evidence.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You read one reply from a client of a business that takes appointments. The client is answering a message about an appointment, a free slot we offered, or a reminder to book again. Decide what they want.

Quote the exact words you decided from in evidence, copied from the message. If no words in the message say it, the intent is other.

attributes.name: intent
attributes.description: One of: yes (confirms, accepts, agrees), no (cannot come, cancels, declines), reschedule (wants a different time), stop (wants no more messages), question (asks something), other.

attributes.name: evidence
attributes.description: The exact words from the message that show the intent, copied, not paraphrased.

parameters.content:
## Act on the reply

YES means whatever we asked this person last. A taken slot is checked against the calendar, not only the log.

## Update the booking calendar

A slot taken from the waitlist is created, a cancelled one removed. An item can go to the calendar and the client both.

## Answer the client

The answer goes back the way the question came: a text to a text, an email to an email.

## Report a failure of the workflow

A fourth entry point, firing only when a run errors. A silent failure looks exactly like a quiet week.
